content.title: Repair-and-Recommit Route | Failure Card, Local Fix, Resumed Progress
content.summary: A radio maker repairs one coil and resumes a hill test. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: A visible failure state precedes the repair. + One bounded intervention addresses one local cause. + Instrument or object feedback proves the change. + The same adult resumes the interrupted route. + The terminal proof is continued action, not text alone.
quick_start.recommended_input: Show one older adult radio maker paused beside a silent field transmitter and two failed test cards. Let a single green meter rise into the safe band while the transmitter remains otherwise unchanged. End at sunrise as the antenna sends one clean pulse toward the valley under the exact line TRY ONE MORE TUNE.
